Every diagnostic check of a fit

Source: R/wildcards.R
get_checks.Rd

Each check diagnostics() runs, with its status, criterion and reference: estimation, class sizes, classification, local independence and information. For a fit, the table is the one diagnostics() computes with its defaults; for a grid, the tables of every candidate are stacked with a first column candidate (a candidate whose estimation failed has no row); for a diagnostics result, its own table.

Usage

get_checks(x)

Arguments

x

A fitted model of any family, an enumeration grid, or the result of diagnostics().

Value

A data frame, one row per check (and candidate): domain, check, level, value, display, criterion, status, detail, reference. Any other object raises latents_not_a_fit.

See also

diagnostics() for the checks and their criteria; get_entropy(), get_classification(), get_avepp(), get_replication(), get_residuals() for the tables behind them; overview().

Examples

fit <- lpa(faithful, c("eruptions", "waiting"), n_profiles = 2,
           n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
get_checks(fit)
#>                domain                                 check       level
